summary: The player weaves through groups of small enemies, using charged shots to disarm several of them while dodging their pink bullets.

events.evidence: HUD cannon meter drops from 1 bar to 0; white cone-shaped wave fires upward.
Charged wave strikes a small enemy on the left; impact flash and hit sound.
Score increases from 345 to 353 and multiplier rises; enemy loses its glow and drifts away.
Player ship moves sharply from the left side toward the center.
HUD cannon meter empties; white arc wave fires toward the center cluster of enemies.
Wave hits the cluster in the middle; targeting reticles flash.
HUD cannon meter drops to 0; white wave fires upward from the right side.
Wave strikes an enemy; score increases from 353 to 369.
Multiplier increases from x1.2 to x1.3 and score increases by a small amount.
HUD cannon meter shows 2 bars before emptying; larger white wave fires up the left side.
Wave hits top-left enemies; circular shockwave ring expands.
Score jumps from 369 to 513 and multiplier rises to x1.5; dark disarmed enemy hulls drift upward.
White arc wave fires upward from bottom center.
Wave passes through the middle without hitting remaining enemies; score remains 513.

readability_issues.issue: The bright white flash on the player ship when charging or grazing is very large and temporarily obscures the ship's exact hitbox.
Enemy bullets and small enemies share a very similar pink/magenta color palette, making them blend together when clustered.
Disarmed enemy hulls turn very dark and are difficult to see against the dark blue playfield.
